font.reason: A compact, neutral Persian UI face that fills the original Inter-like product-navigation role while preserving joined glyphs and the ZWNJ in پروژه‌ها. FaRoot loads it before rendering.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored via FaRoot direction:rtl; the first flex child (the colour marker) is therefore at the right, followed by its Persian label toward the left.
rtlDecisions.why: Icon/bullet placement is part of reading-order navigation semantics in Persian.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original top-to-bottom LABELS order and its six 0.09 stagger windows.
rtlDecisions.why: This is a vertical navigation sequence, whose order is unchanged by RTL; preserving it retains the designed readable cadence.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the scale-led translateY(14→0) entrance and the independent linear translateY(16→-16) drift exactly.
rtlDecisions.why: Vertical motion is physical/universal rather than reading-direction motion; the source prompt defines these as two deliberately decoupled layers.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept position, colour order, gradient angle, radius, scale transform and opacity curve.
rtlDecisions.why: They are symmetrical or decorative, not directional language.

components.motionFidelity: E.outBack, seg windows, opacity multiplier, scale range, vertical offset, gap, hue array, 108-frame duration and all timing values are unchanged. Persian labels vary in length but do not change any beat, stagger count or holding time.
components.rasterHandling: No raster, video, SVG text or textured text assets are used by this component.
components.persianCraft: No letter spacing, uppercase transform or per-character split is used. Labels are whole joined strings; the only ZWNJ-required label is پروژه‌ها. There are no digits, mixed bidi runs, typing, handwriting or character-level reveal effects.

sourceComparison.observations: The upstream frames confirm the intended gradual top-to-bottom row assembly, soft scale settling and final all-six-row hold.

verification.result: blocked before bundling: the Windows environment returns Error: spawn EPERM while Remotion/esbuild starts its service. The harness then masks its own failed bundle result with TypeError: (b.stdout + b.stderr).slice is not a function.
verification.directBundleAttempt: npx remotion bundle ... --log=error produced the same esbuild spawn EPERM.
verification.finalVideoAttempt: Not produced because the same bundler precondition is blocked; no false claim of Persian visual or full-timeline verification is made.
